verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at developer.vanta.com that describes the APIs and MCP server, and confirm that docs pages are served as .md with a pointer back to the llms.txt index. First-party docs add agentskills.io-spec skill files and a docs MCP server that searches the docs and serves every page as a skill.md resource. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a discoverable path (probe found none at common locations), and independent or community reports of agents actually consuming these docs.
